children: RNS Number : 3594T  Guinness VCT PLC  03 September 2026
Intention to Launch an Offer for Subscription
The directors of Guinness VCT plc are pleased to announce their intention to launch a new offer for subscription (the "Offer") of new ordinary shares in the 2026/2027 and 2027/2028 tax years.
Full details of the Offer will be contained in a prospectus that is expected to be published in September 2026.
